description.value:
In your study of planar lore, you have unearthed ways to augment your Eidolon, changing its form or otherwise imbuing it with new abilities.

You gain two evolution feats of your choice. A list of the available options can be found on the Optional Features page. When you gain certain summoner levels, you gain additional evolution feats of your choice, as shown in the Evolution Feats column of the Summoner table.

Additionally, when you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the evolution feats you know and replace it with another evolution feat that you could learn at that level.

If an evolution feat has prerequisites, you must meet them to learn it. You can learn the evolution feat at the same time that you meet its prerequisites. A level prerequisite refers to your level in this class.
